proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ M hM h Φ
  let R : StrongDual 𝕜 E →L[𝕜] StrongDual 𝕜 M := (ContinuousLinearMap.compL 𝕜 M E 𝕜).flip M.subtypeL
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h (Φ.comp R)
  have hval : ∀ f : StrongDual 𝕜 E, f x = Φ (f.comp M.subtypeL) := fun f => congrArg (fun F => F f) hx
  have hxM : x ∈ M := by
    by_contra hn
    have hq : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M)‖ = Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) := QuotientAddGroup.norm_mk x
    have hd : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M)‖ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hq]
      exact fun h0 => hn ((hM.mem_iff_infDist_zero ⟨0, M.zero_mem⟩).mpr h0)
    obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := exists_dual_vector 𝕜 (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M) hd
    let π : E →L[𝕜] (E ⧸ M) := M.mkQ.mkContinuous 1 (fun y => by
      simpa using Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le M y)
    have hπ : ∀ y, π y = Submodule.Quotient.mk y := fun y => rfl
    have h0 : (g.comp π).comp M.subtypeL = 0 := by
      ext m
      simp [hπ, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero M).mpr m.2]
    have h1 := hval (g.comp π)
    rw [h0, map_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ, hg] at h1
    exact hd (by exact_mod_cast h1)
  refine ⟨⟨x, hxM⟩, ?_⟩
  ext g
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := exists_extension_norm_eq M g
  have hfg : f.comp M.subtypeL = g := by
    ext m
    simpa using hf m
  have h1 := hval f
  rw [hfg] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  exact (hf ⟨x, hxM⟩).symm
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (M : Submodule 𝕜 E), IsClosed (M : Set E) → Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 E) → Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 M)
